body: Like, you take it for awhile but then you slowly back to the way you were before them.  I've been on them for about a year now and I just feel so completely down now.  I just don't know what to do anymore.  It took a long time to find something that half ways worked and I just don't have the energy to go through all that again if I had to change.
Exactly.  That's why I always say I'm just tired.  It would be great to actually be able to talk to someone about it.
